name: Elrond
subtitle: Venerable Lord
game_text:
To play, spot an Elf.
At the start of each skirmish involving Elrond, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an <culture>Elven</culture> card, you may heal another Elf.
flavor_text: “‘To me then even our victory can bring only sorrow and parting — but to you hope of joy for a while.’”
